DroidProject.title: DroidProject
DroidProject.description: A user-authored Sketchware-style Android app project containing layout widgets, variables, and event block graphs.

appName.description: Display name of the built Android app project

packageName.description: Java package identifier for generated MainActivity.java and manifest

accentColorHex.description: Primary theme hex color for the project

widgets.description: Ordered list of UI widget definitions placed on the layout canvas

variables.description: Typed variables (int, String, boolean) declared in the project

events.description: Map of event keys (e.g., onCreate, button1_onClick) to lists of logic block nodes

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when project was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when project was last modified (FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

/users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}.description: User-owned Android app builder projects scoped strictly to the authenticated owner UID.
